thread_analysis.thread_summary: Brief operational notice to JVC Kenwood (菅沼様) confirming shipment of the completed Compliance Folder (CD-R) via tracked Japan Post Click Post, following a prior HSP (Hands-Free Profile related) re-test and registration Review Page approval. The message bundles two standing pieces of guidance: Compliance Folder retention/audit obligations, and the free derivative-model addition process for future products sharing the same module and Host Stack.
all_questions_found: (No explicit new question — standard delivery notice bundling retention obligation and derivative addition guidance.)
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: Compliance Folder retention obligation: 1 year post last-Product-List-item discontinuation, for potential SIG audit (vehicle-inspection-certificate analogy); Allion notes no past customer has faced an actual audit. Derivative model addition: same module + Host Stack → free addition via Manage Submitted Products on SIG My Page.
thread_analysis.key_decision_logic: Standard post-delivery communication should proactively address retention/audit obligations and future derivative registration options in the same message to reduce follow-up support burden.
thread_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: Premature disposal of the Compliance Folder before the retention window ends would leave the customer unable to respond to a hypothetical SIG audit.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: Use Compliance Folder delivery as an opportunity to proactively remind customers of both their retention obligation and the free derivative-product registration path, as demonstrated in this message.
